shadowProjectionResearch.note: Stat-prediction MAE is not evidence of profitable prop odds; projections exclude injuries, pace, opponents and live rotations.

settlementAudit.note: Retrospective corroboration is not the same as originally verified settlement. Audit never changes saved outcomes or training eligibility.

historicalPickProjectionReplay.note: Shadow estimates are reconstructed using only games strictly before the recorded slate; not original frozen forecasts, not matchup/injury adjusted, not proof of expected value.

frozenProjectionAccuracy.note: Only projections stored at publication are counted. Legacy picks without frozen projections are excluded.

modelHeadToHead.methodology: For each player/date/stat, compare the existing NBA EDGE 40-game 0.97-weighted projection with a Claude-inspired last-10 and season blended per-minute rate times projected minutes. Train on strictly earlier dates; evaluate both on the same completed player games. Last quarter is a fixed chronological reporting holdout, not a fitted hyperparameter search.
modelHeadToHead.limitations: Not the full Claude NBA-Picks model (injury, defense, odds, rest and market blending unavailable). Stats MAE does not establish prop win rate, ROI or profitable EV. Do not auto-promote based on one retrospective comparison.

contextResearch.limitations: Only games with explicit scoreboard-consistent team, opponent and listed position are compared. Old incomplete history is excluded. Defense uses shrunk per-position residuals from prior eligible player-games; rotation uses a Claude-inspired minutes-rate core. Missing injury/lineup data means effects of injured teammates are NOT modeled. Statistical error is not betting ROI.

rankingMethods.ev: Highest raw estimated EV, one prop per player/date
rankingMethods.risk: Estimated EV * (evidenceScore/100)^2; one prop per player/date

rankingExperiment.note: Both lists share the same pregame eligible candidate set and frozen prices. Overlapping selections are not independent bets. ROI is paper return using archived odds; small samples and uncertain probabilities cannot establish a profitable strategy. No past rankings are reconstructed.

injuryReview.source: ESPN public NBA injury feed (not official NBA report)
injuryReview.note: ESPN listings can be late or incomplete. Not listed does NOT mean healthy. Confirm official NBA injury report and starting lineups before betting.

calibration.note: Overall and by-market summaries include older legacy settlements. Use verifiedOnly for event-confirmed outcomes. Neither proves positive EV; do not train on in-sample data.

reviewChecklist: Verify game date, team, and actual player availability before relying on the pick.
Check injury reports, projected minutes, rotations and rest; model lacks injury adjustment.
Confirm live bookmaker price and line; this export may contain stale odds.
Recalculate EV if odds change; probability is uncalibrated.
Flag correlated props and insufficient history; passing is acceptable.
Check bySide/byMarketAndSide for directional model bias; small samples are inconclusive.
Review settlementAudit discrepancies before trusting historical win rates.
settlementCaveat: New settlements require a matching matchup, game start time and unique ESPN game boxscore. Older results remain unverified legacy records; sportsbook and ESPN event IDs come from different providers and are not directly equal.
